other_conditions: Disability of 40% or more is required
Minimum age: 21 years for male applicants and 18 years for female applicants
Marriage must be solemnized by religious, social custom or legally prescribed by the competent court
Applicant should not be an income taxpayer
Application must be made within one year after the marriage
benefits_summary: A disabled person marrying a non‑disabled partner receives Rs. 2,00,000, while both partners being disabled receive Rs. 1,00,000.
